visualCharacteristics.structure: 2 full-width tab buttons + section-based panels + gate modal

contentPattern: One row per tab, 2 cells: [tab label, e.g. 'Information for Patients'] | [panel key, e.g. 'patient'] (rows: patient, hcp). Key cell optional (derived from the label). Default tab = 'patient' (else the first). Rows containing links (the source's HCP gate) are ignored; no gate is rendered. The block's own section carries Section Metadata Id: HCP. Panels: every following section whose Section Metadata 'Tab' matches a key (data-tab, applied by scripts.js) is moved, in order, into that panel; collection stops at the next tabs-audience section. Hash: #<key> (case-insensitive: #HCP, #hcp, #patient) selects that tab and lands on the bar; #<id> of an element inside a panel (including ids created later by blocks) selects that panel and scrolls to it. ARIA tabs with arrow/Home/End keys.
